caption: The drawing depicts three golden rings, arranged roughly in a triangular pattern near the center of the page, within a rectangular border. Each ring is shown from a different angle. The ring on the upper left is a signet ring with a cross-like engraving on its face, viewed at an oblique angle. The ring on the upper right is shown in a side view, with the face of the ring visible but not clearly detailed. The ring at the bottom is depicted from above, showing the band and its oval shape. The objects are golden-yellow in color, and they are rendered with light shading to give a sense of three-dimensionality. The background of the page is off-white or yellowed with age, and there are some stains and smudges apparent, particularly along the top and bottom edges. The drawing is signed "Frank Nelson" in the bottom right corner, just outside the rectangular border.
title: Gold Ring
